title: chikenLI [end]
description: do you want to add invincible chickens in minecraft?
body:
✨ Key Features
Ranged Attacks: Chickens are now hostile (or defensive) and will fire eggs at players within their line of sight.

Projectiles: The eggs fired by chickens follow custom physics, requiring players to dodge and stay alert even in seemingly safe farm environments.

Cursed Gameplay: Perfect for challenge packs, "cursed" world runs, or simply pranking your friends on a private server.

🛠 Technical Details
Simple & Lightweight: The mod doesn't add heavy assets or complex new entities, ensuring it runs smoothly on any machine.

Purpose: Created as a standalone challenge to spice up the early-game survival experience.
